snippet.title: Curtains the Clown Gameplay Trailer - The Welkin Run
snippet.description:
Ladies and germs, may I present the official pre-alpha gameplay trailer for Curtains the Clown! This video demonstrates the various ways you can use the mechanics to successfully clear all of the obstacles in the most challenging area of the game, The Welkin Ruins. While still in development, the mechanics will remain untouched so everything you see in the trailer will still be possible at the time of release.

Coming Q1 2026 AT THE LATEST

Links:
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766820/Curtains_the_Clown/
Itch.io - https://grimclownjay.itch.io/

-

Music: Danse Macabre - Composed by Camille Saint-Saëns.
Played by: National Philharmonic Orchestra
Conductor: Leopold Stokowski
